europe_now.title: EU migration and asylum policy shifts
europe_now.summary: Asylum applications are plummeting across the European Union as governments advance plans for deportation hubs. Meanwhile, the EU has provided Spain with 115 million euros in aid following the migration crisis in Ceuta.

top_stories.title: Russian Oligarch Legal Challenges and EU Sanctions
top_stories.summary: Russian oligarch Abramovich has lost his third lawsuit in the European Union. Brussels is concurrently planning to implement a tougher sanctions blacklist.

top_stories.title: Google Investment in Finland
top_stories.summary: Google has selected Finland as the location for its largest single investment in Europe. The technology giant's move highlights the country's growing appeal for major digital infrastructure projects.
